name: Six
clause: During your turn, nonland permanent cards in your graveyard have retrace.

needs.proposedSignature: `AltCost.id` gains `'retrace'` (`{ id: 'retrace', from: 'graveyard', cost: { discard: { types: ['Land'] } }, repeatable: true }`) and a static `{ kind: 'grant-alt-cost', filter: Filter, zone: SetZone, who: ScopeWho, altCost: AltCost, condition?: Condition }`
needs.semantics: Retrace lets a card be cast from its owner's graveyard by discarding a land card in addition to its other costs; the card returns to the graveyard on resolution rather than being exiled, so it is repeatable. Six additionally needs the GRANT form: a static that gives a casting permission to cards in a zone other than the battlefield ('nonland permanent cards in your graveyard have retrace'), conditioned on 'during your turn'. Today `grant-ability` / `grant-mana-ability` only reach permanents on the battlefield, so nothing can grant a cost to cards in a graveyard - this is the 9.1 cost-alter 'permission to cast from another zone' family the vocabulary doc already flags.
needs.clause: During your turn, nonland permanent cards in your graveyard have retrace.
